title: Capability
description: Scoped attenuating authority per spec.md §5.5 + I-003 narrowing invariant.

path_prefix.description: Namespace prefix this Capability covers. Sub-Capabilities MUST have a more specific prefix or the same prefix.

op_set.description: Operations permitted by this Capability. Sub-Capabilities MUST have a strict subset.

ttl.description: Time-to-live in seconds. 0 = unbounded. Sub-Capabilities MUST have ttl ≤ delegator's ttl (per I-003).
